beltEngravingFix.why: Men's belt and hornback belt have SERONERA engraved on the bottom bar of the silver buckle (women's belts with gold buckle have no engraving). Batch 3 #18/#19 were missing it.
beltEngravingFix.how: nano_banana_pro 9:16 edit with image_references [finished background, real product photo]: 'keep the first image identical, only show the SERONERA engraving on the lower bar of the buckle as in the second image'.

lessons: outpaint_image from 1:1 to a larger 1:1 changes nothing (no zoom-out). To shrink: first outpaint to 3:2 or 16:9, then to 9:16.
Measure the product top in the image (colour mask) instead of estimating it; the overlap check is only as good as productTop.
For belts with a silver buckle: ask for the engraving explicitly in the prompt, or add it afterwards with the edit above.
